# GP-IMPORT-COMPLEX-FIELD

The report host Gaussian integers are not a field. Compute exact Q(i) reciprocals with a defined tag, test integer units by norm1, and retain the integer characteristic values lambda²-2 for the self-adjoint matrix[[0,1+i],[1-i,0]]. A finite search alone is not no-eigenvalue proof; Lean supplies integer parity obstruction. Output layout: norm;integer_unit;reciprocal_defined;reciprocal2;lambda²-2 for -3..3
